title: 250 Miles of Adventure: Nat Geo on the San Juan Huts
content:
Back in 2010, our buddy Sinuhe Xavier did this video for Nat Geo on the San Juan Huts system. He shot the film on a Canon 5D from his backpack aboard his hardtail. Enjoy this one, and then check out our silly-by-comparison video in our Archives!
